name: apple-and-icloud-mail
description: A platform-agnostic IMAP plugin — portable setup guidance plus bounded connection checks.

interface.longDescription: IMAPlle Now (canonical ID apple-and-icloud-mail) — portable open-source guidance for IMAP setup and bounded connection checks using separately configured tools. Single-P spelling is intentional. Community project; no Apple affiliation. Calendar, Contacts, Drive, Photos, and other Apple services are outside version 0.1.0.
defaultPrompt: Use IMAPlle Now to review my IMAP setup without authenticating.
